note: Private family-run park on the Boatright family farm (opened to RV camping 2017; 19751 Eden Church Rd, Cobbtown), beside the family's stocked fishing lake (Boatright Lake). Nightly, weekly and monthly stays (monthly with a $100 electric deposit); the operator posts no rates. Site 8 is the operator's 'prime lakefront spot, just 20 feet away' from the water; site 9 has a lake view. Kayaking and fishing. --Claude
summary: Operator site (GoDaddy, phone 912-685-2908 matches): confirmed full hookups (water/sewer), 19 spots, nightly/weekly/monthly, booking by contact form/phone, check-in noon/out 11. No rates, amperage, rig length or season posted. Note trimmed of the RV Life line and the sweep's sourcing remarks.
flags: Price/long-stay: the operator posts no rate at all ('Nightly & weekly rates available ... monthly rates plus a $100 electric deposit'; banner 'Short & long term availabilities'), there is no booking engine (contact form only), and RV Life gives only a $ tier with 0 reviews and avg_rate 0 (no camper-reported price). Presence passes: working website with phone 912-685-2908 and Google Maps 4.3 (12 reviews, same phone). If the park is judged long-stay in character (monthly with deposit, 'long term availabilities'), long-stay test 2 fails on 'no posted nightly rate'. Price gate: no gateway within 40 km (Savannah 105 km); family has not stayed.

Waterfront re-audit lead (upward): the operator markets 'lakefront camping' and says 'Site 8 offers a prime lakefront spot, just 20 feet away ... You can throw out a line' (site 9: 'lakeview'); stored 'not waterfront' rests on imagery showing the RV area set back from the pond. At most one site may qualify.
Site count: operator says 19 spots; RV Life lists 9.
